prd-2.impactWhy: The flush tab bar is medium because the mission's point (save/publish/lock) does not depend on it, but it is a stated layout requirement.
prd-2.text: A **flush tab bar** runs edge to edge under the head — Readings / Sources / History — with the current tab underlined. There is no gap at either end.

prd-3.impactWhy: The Save button styling is medium because saving is the point but the exact icon size is presentation, like the health-bar colour example.
prd-3.text: A **Save reading** button carries a small square icon, 16px inside a 34px control, with the label beside it on one line.

prd-4.impactWhy: The Publish button shape is medium because publishing is the point but width and line-wrap are presentation, not whether it works.
prd-4.text: A **Publish board** button is the blue primary action, 160px wide, with "Publish board" on **one line**.

prd-5.impactWhy: The Export CSV button is medium because it is a stated secondary action, not the core save/publish/lock the mission is for.
prd-5.text: An **Export CSV** button sits beside Publish.

prd-6.impactWhy: The stale-readings warning colour is high because a warning chip that reads as a healthy state is exactly the misleading state the PRD says must not happen.
prd-6.text: A **stale-readings chip** reads "2 readings stale" and is **red** (#c0392b) — it is a warning, and it must not read as a healthy state.

prd-7.impactWhy: The notice wrapping is low because it is purely presentational text that nobody would block the merge over.
prd-7.text: A **notice** under the buttons reads "Readings older than six hours are hidden from the public board automatically." It is 230px wide and, as drawn, it takes **two lines**. That is correct, not a defect.

prd-8.impactWhy: Getting to the board screen is medium because it is the means to the lock workflow and clicking the button does reach it.
prd-8.text: **Open the board** is the only way onto the second screen. There is no address for it: a person gets there by clicking.

prd-9.impactWhy: The lock-refuses-while-blank rule is high because locking/publishing the month's note correctly is the point of the second screen.
prd-9.text: On the board screen, a note box and a **Lock the board** button. **Lock refuses while the note is blank**, and publishes once a note is written.

part-helpLink.text: the "Help" link matches the drawing — same icon size, same label on the same number of lines, same place
